experiment: Frozen-routing robustness across the five prespecified calibration batch groupings (FR s0 / FC s0, layers 1/8/16/23)
question: Does freezing the ORIGINAL expert assignments used to build GPTQ calibration Hessians consistently reduce model-level PPL sensitivity to BF16 calibration batch composition?

conditions.OO: GPTQ(X_O, R_O): CTRL ORIGINAL, one reference per strategy
conditions.AO: GPTQ(X_g, R_O): frozen ORIGINAL routing (G20261111 reused, four groupings new)

alignment: (original sequence id, token position): grouping cache row i = union_calibration_ids[i] (verified from each cache manifest); R_O keyed by sequence id; every sequence 512 tokens
intervention: selected_experts replaced inside a verbatim copy of Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock.forward, ONLY during the Hessian-building Profiler run; reconstruction Profiler, inference and PPL use the class forward; the block output under forced routing is discarded (non-sequential calibration)
hessian_semantics: unmodified E3 Profiler + BlockHessianAccumulator: per expert UNWEIGHTED sums over routed tokens of x x^T (gate/up input = MoE-block input) and z z^T (z = act(gate x)*up x computed by the expert with its ORIGINAL BF16 weights), K blocks by chosen order, summed; router weights scale only the expert OUTPUT and are not part of the Hessian
reconstruction: E3 held-out relative reconstruction on ~/moe_cache test rows 2128-2255 (eval_cache_dir), natural routing
invariants: forced routed-token count per expert == R_O count over the chosen sequences (every AO config)
AO routed-token count vector identical across the five groupings for each strategy
G20261111 AO: forced Hessians bitwise == stored (480), re-installed weights digest == stored, re-evaluated PPL == stored exactly

diagnostic_subset.note: prespecified (= the partial-PPL expert-check subset); act-order and diag statistics are recorded for ALL 240 experts

aa_hessians: natural AA_g Hessians are recomputed with the UNMODIFIED Profiler (no GPTQ) for the Hessian diagnostics only; G20261111 must equal the factorial study's AA Hessians bitwise

definitions.SD_ratio[c]: std_g(PPL_AO,g, ddof=1) / std_g(PPL_AA,g, ddof=1), five groupings, strategy c in {FR, FC}
definitions.SD_Delta_ratio: std_g(Delta_AO,g) / std_g(Delta_AA,g), Delta = PPL_FC - PPL_FR (same grouping)
definitions.closer[c]: number of groupings with |PPL_AO,g - PPL_OO| < |PPL_AA,g - PPL_OO| (strategy c)
definitions.preserved[k]: number of groupings with sign(Delta_k,g) == sign(Delta_OO) (Delta_OO = +0.010057), k in {AO, AA}
definitions.undefined_ratio: a denominator SD <= 1e-12 makes the ratio undefined; an undefined ratio never satisfies a <= 0.5 criterion (raw SDs reported)

precedence: RUN-BLOCKED: a required artifact is missing / fails its fingerprint, G20261111 AO does not regress exactly, a routing-alignment or token-count invariant fails, or any AO configuration fails a correctness check
FROZEN-ROUTING-ROBUSTLY-STABILIZES-PPL: SD_ratio[FR] <= 0.5 AND SD_ratio[FC] <= 0.5 AND SD_Delta_ratio <= 0.5 AND closer[FR] >= 4 AND closer[FC] >= 4 AND preserved[AO] >= 4

FROZEN-ROUTING-PARTIALLY-STABILIZES: at least one of (a) SD_ratio[FR] <= 0.5, (b) SD_ratio[FC] <= 0.5, (c) SD_Delta_ratio <= 0.5, (d) closer[FR] >= 4 AND closer[FC] >= 4, (e) preserved[AO] >= 4 AND preserved[AO] > preserved[AA]; the satisfied items are reported
decision_rule.note: exploratory practical criteria, not hypothesis tests; frozen before any new AO quantization or PPL

hard_constraints: no re-selection, seed 0, the five prespecified groupings only, 4 layers, frozen GPTQ / windows / evaluation / reconstruction, no OA runs, no forced routing at inference, no additional runs after results

environment.note: determinism settings are recorded, not changed (changing them would change ORIGINAL numerics)
